newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes lose ground, LLS gains then loses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes lose ground, LLS gains then loses.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes softened in Friday afternoon trading, pressured by technical selling in the paper markets and bearish sentiment in the products.
Traders said the feature in the cash markets has been the fluctuating Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, where barrels were dealt as strong as 22 cts over the West Texas Intermediate/Cushing benchmark.
Prices returned to more moderate levels, to sell at only a 16 cts premium to the WTI, on declining wet Brent values.
"The LLS really came back down on the CFD losses," said a crude trader, who noted the LSL has quieted in the afternoon.
